# Customer Health Scorecard

- **Id:** `sc-72aa08`
- **Domain:** scorecard
- **Status:** active (Company entity)

## Summary

The org-wide company health scorecard. Measures: Product Usage, Support Health, **NPS**
(reads `company.NPS_Score__gc`, set by rule `rul-9f3e21`), Engagement. The NPS measure maps
score ranges to colors (≥ 9 green, 7–8 yellow, ≤ 6 red).

## Key fields

| Direction | Object | Field |
|---|---|---|
| reads | `company` | `NPS_Score__gc` (NPS measure input) |
